page.title: Settings & Readiness
page.purpose: Make local versus remote operation, Cloudflare credential readiness, synchronization, and the /public/* policy understandable and safe to configure.

priorities.statement: The operator can see exactly which capability is blocked and why.
Credential values are write-only and their source, presence, and scope readiness are visible without exposing secrets.
The /public/* policy is narrow, default-off, and visibly separate from primary application protection.
Sync previews changes before applying them.

states.description: Configuration and credential metadata are loading.
Mode, credential presence, sync controls, and public-asset policy are visible.
Some readiness metadata is unavailable while known values remain visible.
One or more required credentials are absent; the missing field and affected capabilities are named.
Credentials are present but a required Cloudflare permission is missing for the selected capability.
The proposed ingress or Access policy changes are shown before apply.
Credential or configuration mutation succeeded and reports its redacted result.
Configuration failed to load or save and provides retry.

claims.statement: Readiness names the exact capability affected by missing credentials or insufficient scopes rather than showing a generic unavailable state.
The settings experience never displays stored secret values after save.
The public-assets policy states that only /public/* can bypass Access and that the primary application remains protected.
